title: The review's cost reads every worked item of the sprint: a headless worker's closed session is distilled before the review reads cost
goal: When a sprint's review runs backlog.py cost --rework SP, every item a dispatched worker worked has work lines or cost names the item whose session is closed and not distilled, and the review step (or dispatch at the worker's exit) runs the distill for such a session, so the figures are not provisional for most of the sprint
notes: Retrospective of SP-g2ssvhi2: at the close, after nine worker sessions (and two resumes) had exited, backlog.py cost --rework SP-g2ssvhi2 had work lines for 3 items (ST-5z4e6z4i, ST-h66j7wm5, ST-oftholty); each land printed 'work rows are late' and ST-h66j7wm5's named a session 'closed and not distilled'. The workers' result.json figures add to about $9.9 for the sprint, which cost could not show. The sprint's own goal fixed the naming (land says why), not the distill's timing. SP-sc5yk65l retrospective, recurrence: the review's cost read only ST-5zcl2sof's worker; the closed sessions of the ST-o4drfrv5 and ST-qtbpuyff workers were not distilled yet (land printed 'work rows are late' for both). Triage 2026-10-16: its check names a test the pruned suite (D-6kei5o2z) lacks; no planted check yet: Needs headless-session spool state plus ql_distill timing (cost --rework, dispatch exit hook); no cheap planted input drives a closed-undistilled worker session. Recurred in SP-dulvwwjc: cost --rework read 0 item lines at review and close; land warned of missing or late work rows for every dispatched worker.
